metadata.title: Execute Work Item Sniffing
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Execute work item sniffing with code cross-reference. Analyzes the git diff against the base branch, identifies affected endpoints and business logic changes, traverses the work item hierarchy, and cross-references acceptance criteria against code changes to find gaps, unstated behaviors, and risks.

output.description: Sniffing findings including scope/impact, risks, cross-service concerns, code changes, and requirements vs code mapping

prerequisites: Work item details fetched and stored in memory
Sniffing guidelines loaded from qa-guidelines repo
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Run git diff against base_branch from qaConfig to identify all changed files
Group changed files by type: controllers, services, models, tests, config, other
Identify endpoints affected by changes and business logic modifications
Traverse work item hierarchy: fetch parent (1 level up). Only go further (grandparent/epic) if parent lacks acceptance criteria
Cross-reference acceptance criteria vs code changes: flag requirements not in code, code not in requirements, and unstated behaviors
Exploration budget: git diff = High priority, parent WI = Medium, grandparent/epic = Low, cross-repo = Low (only if cross-service calls found in code)
Stop condition: Can articulate what the feature does, what flows are affected, and what could go wrong

read: memory.json (for work item details, config, sniffing guidelines)
Changed files from git diff (controllers, services, models)

tools: git diff - Diff against base_branch to identify changed files
read_file - Read changed files for analysis
grep - Search for patterns in changed code (endpoints, service calls)
bestPractices: Start with git diff as the primary source of truth for what changed
Group files by architectural layer for structured analysis
Focus on user-visible behavior changes, not internal refactoring
When traversing hierarchy, stop at the first level that provides sufficient context
Cross-reference should produce actionable findings, not just observations
Flag security-relevant changes (authentication, authorization, data access) as high-priority risks

substeps.name: Run git diff and group files
substeps.description: Run git diff against base_branch from config, group changed files by type
actions: Run git diff against base_branch (from qaConfig) to get list of all changed files
Group files by type: controllers, services, models, tests, config, migrations, other
For each changed file, note the type of change: added, modified, deleted
Identify the primary areas of change (which services, which layers)

substeps.name: Identify endpoints and business logic changes
substeps.description: Analyze changed files to identify affected endpoints and business logic
actions: Read changed controller/route files to identify affected API endpoints
Read changed service files to identify business logic modifications
Read changed model files to identify data model changes
Note new dependencies, changed method signatures, modified validation rules
Summarize: what endpoints are affected, what business logic changed, what data flows are impacted

substeps.name: Traverse work item hierarchy
substeps.description: Fetch parent work item (1 level), go further only if parent lacks acceptance criteria
actions: Fetch parent work item using relations from the work item details
Check if parent has acceptance criteria
If parent has AC: record parent context and stop hierarchy traversal
If parent lacks AC: fetch grandparent (go one more level up)
Budget: parent = Medium priority, grandparent/epic = Low priority
Record hierarchy context: parent title, parent AC (if any), epic/feature context

substeps.name: Cross-reference AC vs code
substeps.description: Compare acceptance criteria against code changes to find gaps and unstated behaviors
actions: For each acceptance criterion: check if corresponding code changes exist
For each code change: check if it maps to an acceptance criterion
Flag: requirements not covered in code (AC without matching code)
Flag: code changes not in requirements (code without matching AC)
Flag: unstated behaviors (implicit behaviors in code not mentioned in AC)
Classify each finding: gap, extra, unstated, aligned

substeps.name: Store findings in memory
substeps.description: Compile and store all sniffing findings in structured format
actions: Store scopeAndImpact: summary of what changed, affected endpoints, affected flows
Store risks: potential failure modes, edge cases, security concerns
Store crossServiceConcerns: any cross-service calls found, upstream/downstream impacts
Store codeChanges: grouped file changes with descriptions
Store requirementsVsCode: mapping of each AC to code status (covered/not-covered/partial)
Include cross-service analysis only if cross-service calls were found in code changes

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Can articulate what the feature does, what flows are affected, what could go wrong (stop condition met)
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Run git diff and group files by type -> Identify affected endpoints and business logic changes -> Traverse work item hierarchy (parent, conditionally grandparent) -> Cross-reference AC vs code changes -> Store all findings in memory. Exploration stops when the stop condition is met: can articulate what the feature does, what flows are affected, and what could go wrong.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Work item details, sniffing guidelines, qaConfig (base_branch)
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: sniffingFindings object with scopeAndImpact, risks, crossServiceConcerns, codeChanges, requirementsVsCode
fields: Information Produced: sniffingFindings.scopeAndImpact, sniffingFindings.risks, sniffingFindings.crossServiceConcerns, sniffingFindings.codeChanges, sniffingFindings.requirementsVsCode
Decisions Made: Hierarchy traversal depth, exploration budget allocation
Notes: Stop condition assessment, cross-service calls detected, security-relevant changes
